uncertainty: 10000 percentile bootstrap resamples of static queries; conditions remain clustered
scope: Specific existing LeWM checkpoints; not a training-seed population estimate or closed-loop CEM.

protocol.candidate_rule: shared original five-step query actions multiplied by amplitude
protocol.goal_rule: slowest track speed original-query endpoint, shared across speeds
protocol.query_rule: all 300 registered Development static queries per track; no score filtering
protocol.cost: Euclidean final agent-to-goal distance in pixels
protocol.history_control: each other speed history in same track; average over all wrong histories
